name: MasterDC Kanice AI Data Center
notes: MasterDC announced an AI-focused data center in Kanice near Brno, planned to start operations in autumn 2026; source states total planned site power capacity up to 25 MW.

name: MasterDC Brno
notes: Official MasterDC facility page identifies its Brno data center at Cejl 20 with 750 m2 floor space, expandable by 500 m2, N x 100 Gbps connectivity, UPS and generator backup.

name: Faster DC Brno
notes: Faster's official data-centre service page describes an operational Brno data centre with redundant systems; DataCenterMap locates Faster DC Brno at Jarni 1064/44g.

name: Datacentrum TH Brno
notes: Nej Business materials identify TH Brno at Palavske namesti 4343/11 as an established Brno data centre with 24/7/365 monitoring, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certification, and multiple halls.

name: Datacentrum TH Ivancice
notes: Nej Business describes the Ivancice facility as a data centre on a main optical backbone route and suitable for geo-redundancy with TH Brno; DataCenterMap reports 650 m2 across seven technology rooms.

name: CRA DC Luzice
notes: Official CRA page states CRA is 100% owner of Datove centrum Luzice s.r.o.; Tier III facility near Hodonin with 99.982% availability, N+1 redundancy, and capacity up to 82 racks. DCD reported CRA/Cordiant acquisition in Dec. 2023.

name: CRA DC Brno
notes: CRA's official data-centres pages list DC Brno among its regional data centre footprint for server and ICT hosting services.

name: ZONER DC Brno Nove Sady
notes: ZonerCloud official technology page identifies ZONER DC in Brno, Nove Sady as its own Tier III-classified data center with rack capacity for up to 640 servers; Cejl/Kovoterm is used for backup and disaster recovery.

name: DC PVT Brno (T-Mobile CZ)
notes: Data-center directories list T-Mobile's DC PVT Brno at Veveri 2581/102 in Brno-Zabovresky as an operational colocation facility; operator primary page was not found during this pass.

name: Datacentrum Moravia
notes: MERIT's official opening notice says Datacentrum Moravia opened on 19 Jun. 2008 in Olomouc; the facility site says it was built and put into operation in June 2008 for housing, hosting and virtual hosting.

name: Palacky University Olomouc-Holice data centers
developer: Palacky University Olomouc / MERIT GROUP a.s.
notes: MERIT's official references describe delivery and equipment of new data centers in the Olomouc-Holice campus for Palacky University, including cooling, UPS, fire suppression and Dell/VMware server infrastructure, with work noted from 2018 to present.

name: CRA DC Zlin
notes: CRA official data-centres pages list DC Zlin among the company's regional data centres; third-party directory confirms a CRA-operated Zlin data center.

name: Adaptivity Data Center Zlin
notes: Adaptivity's official site markets a modern secured Zlin datacenter for rack housing, server housing and server hosting, built to Tier 3 quality; directories locate it at Jana Antonina Bati 5542.

name: NWT DC Silo Zlin
notes: NWT's official DC Silo page describes its data centre/cloud service for virtual machines, storage, backup and replication; DataCenterMap locates NWT DC Silo at tr. Tomase Bati 269 in Zlin.

name: Datove Centrum Monaco
notes: Directories list Datove Centrum Monaco at Jaktare 1475, Uherske Hradiste, operated by SYNOT ICT Services, offering housing, hosting and cloud/IAAS services; DataCenterMap notes Tier III design and ISO27001.

name: ANAFRA Bezrucova Data Center
notes: ANAFRA official sources state the company built a Tier III data center in Roznov pod Radhostem; a 23 Mar. 2023 company release says it opened the first public data center in Roznov pod Radhostem.

name: IT4Innovations National Supercomputing Center data room
notes: IT4Innovations official pages state it operates Czechia's most powerful supercomputing systems in Ostrava; the infrastructure page describes a 500 m2 data room with raised floor and water-cooled rack support.

name: IT4Innovations PROJECT Data Storage
notes: Official IT4Innovations page says PROJECT Data Storage was installed in March 2021 and is used to store and back up data processed or generated on the Ostrava supercomputers.

name: CRA DC Ostrava
notes: CRA official pages list DC Ostrava in the company's regional footprint; Hospodarske noviny reported the Ostrava regional data centre opening with 26 racks, while DataCenterMap locates it at Vysilac Hostalkovice.

name: TH Ostrava
notes: Nej Business offers housing in its Ostrava data centre; DataCenterMap describes the TH Ostrava facility in the Ostravia Trade building with more than 100 m2 and three halls.

name: DC XEM Ostrava (T-Mobile CZ)
notes: Data-center directories list DC XEM Ostrava at Na Desatem 3341/6 in Moravska Ostrava as an operational T-Mobile Czech Republic colocation facility; DataCenterMap notes Tier 3 and ISO27001.

name: K2 Data Center Ostrava
notes: K2 official pages state the company operates and offers data-center services from its Ostrava-Privoz site; DataCenterMap lists K2 Data Center at Koksarni 1097/7.
